preText: If you’ve ever wondered how Aladdin’s princess gets that shiny, gorgeous hair, look no further than her name—Jasmine.
summary: The flowers of the Arabian Jasmin plant have long been steeped in water and used as a conditioning rinse to smooth strands and reduce frizz because of their moisturizing properties. Jasmin leaf extract is believed to strengthen hair’s roots, preventing brittleness and enhancing shine.

sections.heading: Is it any good?
content: But growing a head of enviable hair is just one small perk of Jasmin. In Ayurvedic medicine, it's heralded as a remedy for, well, just about everything that ails you—from a headache and fever to itches and wounds. The fragrant, beautiful herb is packed with powerful antiseptic, anesthetic and anti-inflammatory properties, and is so highly regarded in India that brides are practically dripping in the fragrant blooms during their wedding celebrations.

Considered a floral “super-water,” Jasmin Water contains active components from the Jasmin plant. While basic water tends to dry the skin and scalp, all super-waters have properties that purify, soothe and soften. Depending on the plant, and the part being used (leaves, flowers, etc.), super-waters will have their benefits linked to their specific composition.
The main component in hair care products is water, yet it doesn’t bring any specific benefits. Replacing plain old H2O with a super-water infuses products with extra scalp and hair helpers.

sections.heading: Where It’s Sourced
content: Native to India, jasminum sambac is a climbing shrub used in many traditional rituals in Asia. Used to flavor green tea, this “superwater” is also known in the ayurvedic medicine for its antibacterial, antioxidant and anti-inflammatory virtues.

The way to obtain it is simple and sustainable. First, leaves or flowers are put in warm water (kind of like making tea on a larger scale). The steam is then cooled and collected to create the water extract. This process allows for active agents from the plant to be obtained without altering it, all without the use of synthetic solvents or chemical treatments. At Prose, we choose organic plants to be sure that no chemicals are left behind.
